fusions.name: Reaping Arc
fusions.desc: Sweeps the curved blade through a wide arc 3 tiles ahead, dealing 28 damage to everything in it and ignoring their armour.

fusions.name: Ripe for Cutting
fusions.desc: Throws the blade at a target at or below 25% health, dealing 20 damage and leaving it [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hooked Guard
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 30% of the damage aimed at you is turned back on whoever dealt it, and your armour rises by 8%.

fusions.name: Curve Past the Plate
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 12% of the target's armour.
